settings.text: 16,000mAh jump starter with 2500A peak current and 60W USB-C Power Delivery.

settings.image_alt: A3 jump starter, cable and clamp set
settings.heading: 2500A peak current in the A3 configuration
settings.body: A3 is offered in one configuration: 16,000mAh / 59.2Wh with 800A starting current and 2500A peak current. Confirm vehicle voltage and engine requirements in the manual before use.

settings.image_alt: A3 intelligent clamps with connection protection
settings.heading: Clear connection cues before current flows
settings.body: The clamp visual communicates the protection-oriented connection routine. Follow polarity, clamp and vehicle-manufacturer guidance every time you use a jump starter.

settings.image_alt: A3 display and USB-C PD60W power information
settings.heading: One USB-C port for fast input and everyday output
settings.body: USB-C Power Delivery supports input and output up to 60W. Open the technical profile only when you need the detailed voltage and current information.

settings.image_alt: A3 intelligent display showing battery and power information
settings.heading: Read battery, input and output status on the unit
settings.body: The display shows battery percentage and active power information, so the status is visible before a roadside start or when charging a device.

settings.heading: Integrated lighting is part of the emergency kit
settings.body: Choose steady, strobe or SOS light modes when extra visibility is needed. Refer to the product manual for operating guidance and use the light only where it is safe to do so.

settings.image_alt: A3 jump starter shown for 12V vehicle use
settings.heading: Match the jump starter to the vehicle before purchase
settings.body: Start with the 12V application and confirm the vehicle and engine requirements before use. That check matters more than a generic compatibility promise.

settings.image_alt: A3 jump starter package contents including case and clamps
settings.heading: A carry case, cable and clamps stay together
settings.body: The A3 pack includes the unit, smart clamp, USB-C cable, EVA case, manual and color box, shown here so the included items are easy to see.

settings.image_alt: A3 jump starter and carry case packed in a vehicle for a road trip
settings.heading: A road-ready carry kit for the CY-A3-GY
settings.body: This product page is built around the CY-A3-GY: 16,000mAh, a protective case, smart clamp and USB-C cable kept together for travel.

settings.heading: Faster device power with a stronger emergency core
settings.lede: A3 is offered in one 16,000mAh configuration, with the product, kit and technical details all kept on one page.

settings.heading: A3 technical specifications
settings.lede: Open a category only when you need the detail. A3 is offered here in one 16,000mAh configuration.

settings.question: How many A3 variants are confirmed?
settings.answer: One: 16,000mAh in the documented gun-gray / black-silver appearance, SKU CY-A3-GY.

settings.question: What does PD60W mean here?
settings.answer: The USB-C port supports Power Delivery input and output up to 60W, with 5V, 9V, 12V, 15V and 20V profiles up to 3A.

settings.question: What is included?
settings.answer: The documented pack contains the unit, smart clamp, USB-C cable, EVA case, manual and color box.

settings.question: Can I use A3 on any vehicle?
settings.answer: No single jump starter is suitable for every vehicle or battery condition. Confirm voltage and engine requirements, then follow both manuals before use.
